FengByX/Pawchive.body:
A refined, smooth third-party Android client that brings you the full experience of the Pawchive platform.
Aggregates creator content from platforms such as Patreon, Fanbox, and Discord, with support for browsing, searching, favorites, and immersive media playback. --- ## Highlights ### Content Browsing - **Home feed**: Paginated loading of the latest content, with keyword filtering; optional "show only one post per author" and "hide posts from favorited creators" - **Creator profile**: Paginated browsing of posts / announcements / linked accounts / similar creators (swipe left or right to switch), tag filtering, and a follower card overview - **Post details**: Full body text (whitelist HTML rendering), comments, revision history, attachment downloads - **Multi-platform aggregation**: Patreon / Fanbox / Discord and other sources, with platform tags color-coded by brand ### Precise Search - **Keyword search**: Searches posts and creators simultaneously; switch between them with tabs - **File hash reverse lookup**: Paste a file hash (MD5 / SHA-256) into the search box to trace a material's source; Discord results are supported - **Offline full-text search**: Chinese word-segmentation index based on Room FTS4; search favorited content even when offline - **Search history**: Stored locally with a configurable retention limit (5–50), supporting single-entry deletion and one-tap clearing ### Immersive Media - **Large image viewer**: Pinch-to-zoom, double-tap zoom, boundary-constrained dragging - **Animated image playback**: GIF / animated WebP / animated HEIF, with a "GIF" badge in lists - **Video playback**: Media3 ExoPlayer with a Bilibili-style controller, variable playback speed, resume from last position, and picture-in-picture. Fullscreen and inline modes share the same player instance, so entering or exiting fullscreen causes zero rebuffering, and the picture scales with its aspect ratio preserved - **Multi-level fallback**: Prefers original images and automatically falls back to thumbnails when they are missing ### Favorites and Accounts - **Multi-account switching**: Favorites, history, and download data are isolated between accounts - **Cloud favorites**: After login, favorited posts and creators are synced, and the cache is invalidated immediately after writes. When offline, operations are queued automatically and written in the background once connectivity returns - **Local favorites**: No login required; favoriting also builds an offline archive index - **Offline reading**: Full text of favorited posts is archived (Room FTS4), so it can be searched and read without a connection ### Subscriptions and Notifications - **Creator subscriptions**: Follow favorite creators and automatically check for new posts on a periodic schedule (interval adjustable, minimum 15 minutes); optional "subscribe on favorite" - **System notifications**: Instant push when new posts are detected, which can be turned off at any time - **In-app notification center**: Reachable from the bell icon on the home page, with an unread count badge that updates in real time; supports marking single or all items as read, and the subscription management page allows unsubscribing at any time ### Download Center - **HTTP Range resumable downloads**: Pausing keeps temporary files and persists resume points to the database, so downloads still resume from the breakpoint after the app restarts. If the server does not support Range requests, it automatically falls back to a full download - **Independent task notifications**: Each task has its own notification, showing progress percentage, downloaded size, and so on…

Fishsb/dsh-prompt-enhancer.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: ✨ One-click prompt enhancement + 💬 Speech recognition (auto-stops when you finish speaking · cloud/local dual engine) · Includes 🔁 one-click restart for service anomalies
Fishsb/dsh-prompt-enhancer.body:
# dsh-prompt-enhancer

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin. **Two core capabilities**:

- ✨ **Prompt enhancement**: Rewrite the input-box draft with one click. Undo if unsatisfied.
- 💬 **Speech recognition**: Stops automatically after you finish speaking. Cloud / local dual engine, usable offline. The recognized text fills the draft.

## ✨ Two Core Features

### 1. Prompt Enhancement (✨)

The ✨ button in the input toolbar triggers a separate LLM call that rewrites the current draft directly. You can keep refining it, undo the change, or cancel while enhancement is running.

- **One-click enhancement**: The ✨ button triggers a separate LLM call that replaces the draft directly. You can keep refining, undo, or cancel during enhancement.
- **5 optimization modes**: Basic (send directly) / Light (references the previous conversation turn) / Standard (rules + retrieval) / Expert (task analysis + full retrieval) / One-click release (generates a complete development spec)
- **Memory toggle**: When enabled, the multi-turn “optimize → edit → re-optimize” sequence before sending accumulates into a memory chain. The next round takes in this history and picks up the direction of your edits. Sending a message clears the chain. When disabled, reading and writing stop completely.
- **Model chain**: Tries multiple models in order. You can add, remove, and reorder models, toggle thinking, and run inline connectivity tests.

### 2. Speech Recognition (💬)

Click the 🎤 record button next to the input box and speak. Recognition uses either **cloud** Qwen3-ASR or **local offline** SenseVoice (dual engine). Then optional normalization removes filler words, the result fills the draft, and you can optimize it with one click. **Recording stops automatically after a pause** (VAD silence detection). Audio is relayed in memory only and never written to disk.

- **Dual engine**: Cloud Qwen3-ASR or local offline SenseVoice (framework plus optional download, slim release package)
- **Auto-stop after speaking**: VAD silence detection, no manual stop needed (recording ends automatically after at most 60 seconds)
- **Hotkey wake-up**: Record a global hotkey. Supports both tap and long-press triggers.
- **Text normalization**: Recognition results can optionally be normalized by the base LLM to remove colloquial phrasing
- **Auto-enhance**: When enabled, prompt enhancement triggers automatically once recognized text fills the draft

## 🔧 Other Capabilities

- 🌐 **Multilingual**: Buttons and copy follow the DSH interface language (Chinese / English)

## 🚀 Installation

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Fishsb/dsh-prompt-enhancer#v3.4.1
```

After installing, restart DSH (`dsh web`). If the ✨ button appears in the input toolbar, the installation succeeded.

It fixes the problem where the plugin was rejected by the host compatibility gate on DSH `0.2.0` and later, which made the ✨/🎤 buttons and the settings page card disappear (Issue #11 / #12). The command above installs this tag directly. If you installed according to the old instructions, …

HanZijie/agentos-android.description: AgentOS for Android — system-level Agent runtime, AOSP integration, ROM and device support. One root, and turn your phone into a “Doubao Phone”!
HanZijie/agentos-android.body:
Multiple apps share the same Agent runtime, so each one doesn't have to bundle a full Agent.

--- ## Core Capabilities The same app can play both of these roles at once. Users can start a task right inside the app they're already using, without first going to a unified chat entry point. > [!NOTE] > This is currently a **prototype**, deployed as a Magisk / KernelSU module on rooted Android phones, with no ROM replacement required. Root is the current means of deployment and process supervision, not the project's core claim. Both integration paths have been demonstrated on real devices, but the sample apps are provided by this project, and permission controls for third-party apps are still coarse; see [Current status and boundaries](#当前状态与边界). --- ## Demo Two on-device demos, each corresponding to one of the two integration relationships above. ### Main demo: App → Agent Notes is a sideloaded app. It contains a memo; tapping a button hands the text to AgentOS, and the Agent reads out the time and creates a calendar event and an alarm. Notes itself has no calendar or alarm permissions and no model key. Key frames, left to right: after tapping the AgentOS button, confirm the text to be sent; **on first use, AgentOS shows “Allow “Notes” to use AgentOS?”** (showing the package name and signature digest, with focus defaulting to “Deny”); back in Notes, the panel shows 1 event and 1 alarm created; in the calendar, Saturday 15:00 “Meeting with Mr. Wang (Conference Room 3)”. Click the image to watch the full screen recording (real device, real speed, no acceleration, 44 seconds): [demo3.mp4](https://github.com/HanZijie/agentos-android/blob/HEAD/docs/assets/demo3.mp4). The flow: open the memo “This week's schedule” → tap the AgentOS button → confirm the text → authorize on first use, tap Allow → return to Notes to see the result → jump to Calendar and Alarm respectively (“Running” at 07:00 every Monday) to confirm. > **What this demo verifies:** An app doesn't need to bundle an Agent to gain cross-app task handling through a shared runtime; the task is initiated from the original app, and progress and results also return to that app. A few points to note: - Notes plays both roles: it calls the Agent via the `acp-android` SDK, and it exposes its own note tools to the Agent through an embedded plugin. It is this project's sample app, not an external third party. - Authorization is requested only once; it can be revoked later in AgentOS settings, and revoking immediately cancels that app's in-progress tasks. - Notes requests only two tools from the Agent: `event_create` and `alarm_create`. This is the minimum scope it chose for itself, to guard against prompt injection in the memo text; AgentOS does not force third parties to do this (see [Current status and boundaries](#当前状态与边界)). -…

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
```

Suzanne-Li/charge-insight.description: An intelligent data query and anomaly analysis Agent for charging and battery-swap operations, built on Spring Boot and Spring AI
Suzanne-Li/charge-insight.body:
# ChargeInsight

ChargeInsight is a natural-language data analysis system built for charging operations scenarios. Users can run metric queries, trend analysis, ranking comparisons, and anomaly attribution by region, city, charger cluster, and time range. The system orchestrates data tools through a controlled Agent Runtime, and improves analysis accuracy, safety, and traceability through hybrid retrieval, controlled Text-to-SQL, layered memory, and observability.

**Tech stack:** Spring Boot, MySQL, Redis, Embedding, BM25, RRF, JSqlParser, MCP, Docker

## Project Highlights

- **Controlled Agent Runtime:** For operational metrics, trends, rankings, and anomaly attribution, a finite state machine fixes the chain "next-step decision → tool execution → observation feedback → result validation → conclusion generation". Anomaly attribution makes at most one additional call based on observation results, avoiding blind batch calls and keeping a full-chain audit.
- **Hybrid retrieval enhancement:** For colloquial operational questions with ambiguous semantics, uses Embedding vector retrieval plus BM25 recall, fused and ranked with RRF. Retrieval Hit@3 reaches 95.83%, improving the stability of knowledge hits.
- **AST-validated safe SQL fallback:** For ad-hoc analysis that fixed tools cannot cover, builds a Text-to-SQL chain: "natural language parsing → SQL generation → JSqlParser AST validation → EXPLAIN pre-check → read-only execution → one repair attempt". View allowlists, regional date constraints, and LIMIT prevent cross-region queries, full table scans, and oversized results. In the versioned SQL safety regression, both valid-query pass-through and dangerous-query interception are at 100%.
- **Layered memory system:** Runtime working state stores the current analysis scope, plan, and observations. MySQL persists sessions, and when the sliding window overflows, a structured summary is generated. User-confirmed preferences are vectorized to enable per-user isolated long-term semantic recall.
- **Harness Trace observability:** Builds a versioned Harness regression covering colloquial retrieval, planning routing, SQL safety, and anomaly attribution. Links state transitions, tool call results, and local MCP ticket audits through a Trace ID, supporting trace-based replay of anomaly scenarios and problem localization.

│   ├── api          # Agent, SSE, Trace, evaluation, and controlled SQL interfaces
│   ├── chat         # Sessions and optional Redis short-term memory

coffin299/VRCast.body:
# VRCast

A lightweight standalone runtime for 3D avatars for VRChat. Instead of requiring a full Unity project per avatar, it works with each avatar on its own. It aims to display and track avatars easily, like VSeeFace, and output them to streaming software such as OBS.

```text
VRChat avatar (Unity / VCC project)          VRM avatar (VRoid, etc.)
        ↓  com.vrcast.converter (Editor-only package)      │
MyAvatar.vrcaster                                    MyAvatar.vrm (no conversion needed)
        ↓                                                │
VRCast.exe (Runtime)  ←──────────────────────────────────┘
        ↓
OBS (Window Capture / Game Capture / Spout2) / virtual camera (Discord / Zoom, etc.)
```

The design goal is that users do not need to keep the Unity Editor, VCC, or VRChat projects running at all times.

- Website (overview and help; available in Japanese / English / Korean / Simplified and Traditional Chinese. Defaults to the browser language. Light / dark): <https://coffin299.github.io/VRCast/>
  (Source is on the [`webpage` branch](https://github.com/coffin299/VRCast/tree/webpage); the branch root is published via GitHub Pages)

# Classroom Widget

A classroom widget for teachers that helps them manage classes and track student attendance.

## Running

- Install dependencies first

```
pnpm install
```

- Run

```
pnpm dev
```

## Development Standards and Verification

Development and review follow the [Project Development and Acceptance Standards](https://github.com/flicoH/ClassroomToolkit/blob/HEAD/docs/development-standards.md). The recognition rules for course PDFs are also described in the [Course PDF Recognition Benchmark](https://github.com/flicoH/ClassroomToolkit/blob/HEAD/docs/semester-reports-setup.md#课程-pdf-识别基准). User-facing dialogs must use the in-site components; the browser's native `alert/confirm/prompt` are prohibited. Behavior changes must include corresponding tests and code comments that explain the key constraints.

Before committing, run the full automated verification:

```bash
pnpm verify
```

This command runs the standards checks, the Backend/Web/Admin tests, and builds for all three ends. GitHub Actions for Pull Requests also runs the same command.

## Port Notes

- 3000 is the backend API port
- 3001 is the client access port
- 8080 is the admin port

## Backend

- Built with nestjs+typescript+typeOrm+mysql.

### Database Migrations

TypeORM automatic synchronization must not be enabled for production or existing databases:

```env
TYPEORM_SYNCHRONIZE=false
TYPEORM_MIGRATIONS_RUN=false
```

This is the official website page of the Open Atom Club at Huazhong University of Science and Technology.

## Adding and Modifying Pages

This website uses the [Minimal Mistakes theme](https://mmistakes.github.io/minimal-mistakes/). For details on customizing the project, refer to the theme's documentation.

To add new pages (Wiki / News), refer to `_template.md` in `pages/_wiki` and `pages/_news` respectively.

To set a post author, add the author information in [`_data/authors.yml`](https://github.com/hust-open-atom-club/OpenAtomClub/blob/HEAD/_data/authors.yml) (refer to the existing entries), then specify `author: key` in the page (only one author is supported).

## Local Preview and Build

1. Set up a Ruby development environment: install Ruby following the [Ruby installation guide on Runoob](https://www.runoob.com/ruby/ruby-installation-windows.html), then run `gem install bundler`
2. Run `bundle install --path=vendor/bundle` to install the dependency packages
3. Run `bundle exec jekyll serve`, after which the site can be previewed at <http://localhost:4000/>
4. The command to build the entire site is

   ```shell
   bundle exec jekyll build
   ```

   Appending `--profile` to the command shows a build performance profile (time taken per source file), and appending `--trace` outputs a stack trace on errors.

   For production deployment, the environment variable `JEKYLL_ENV=production` must be set; see the GitHub Actions workflow configuration for details.

isac322/homelab.body:
# Homelab GitOps and host management

Argo CD manages the Kubernetes desired state, `system-manager` manages Linux hosts, and `nix-darwin` manages macOS hosts. Host and WireGuard authoritative data are in `nix/lib/topology.nix`, and private keys and PSKs are not stored in plaintext in Git or the Nix store.

## Active topology

```bash
nix run .#homelab-host -- inventory
```

- Linux: `n2p1`, `n2p2`, `rpi4`, `rpi5`, `rock5bp`, `macmini`
- macOS: `bhyoo-macbook-pro`
- `wg0`: 21 links from the 7-node full mesh and 14 `/32` edge links through rpi5
- Total required links: 35. `linkId` is immutable.
- The 6 links where the MacBook is one endpoint, and the edge links, have `managed=false`. Only links whose both Linux bundles are owned by this repository are targets for PSK generation and rotation.

## Secret model

WireGuard ciphertext is placed in `nix/secrets/wireguard/hosts/<nodeId>.sops.yaml`. Each bundle is encrypted to three recipients: the node's host-local age identity, the online operator identity used for routine SOPS work, and the offline recovery identity used only for emergency recovery. One host identity is created per node, while the operator and recovery identities are shared across all host bundles. K3s node bundles store the existing cluster's canonical server token as byte-exact base64. `REPLACE_WITH_*` recipient values are placeholders that intentionally block deployment.
The secret app in this repository uses `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/sops/age/keys.txt` as the online operator key file when `SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE` is not set…

rRanker is a multi-rhythm-game data management app. In one app, you can view player data, best scores, full score records, song libraries, and song details for different games and accounts, and use practical tools built for each game.

- **Data queries**: View player overviews, best scores, full score records, song libraries, and song details, with search, filtering, and sorting based on what each game supports.

# Harvester

All AI-generated code was entirely rewritten by hand, in order to learn something and at the same time solve current problems.
The script now uses less CPU time by reducing the spawning of xray cores and other optimizations. Unnecessary buffers and memory-hungry vectors were also removed.
The pipeline has become more linear, the code more readable, and more context was added to errors. In the future, xray configs may be updated via gRPC instead of restarts.

# Proxy List

## Project Overview

I found an online proxy webpage that's pretty interesting. Its proxies are updated fairly quickly, so I scraped it. The proxies are basically all usable. It's not one of those sites with 10,000 proxies where only a few actually work.

The page https://tomcat1235.nyc.mn/ is quite comprehensive. If you're interested, go scrape it yourself.

## Features

- ⚡ Automatically fetches the latest proxy list
- 🔄 Scheduled updates (runs once every hour)
- 📝 Standard format output: `protocol://ip:port [location]`
- 🌍 Includes geolocation information
- 📊 Supports multiple proxy protocols (HTTP, SOCKS5, etc.)

```bash
python generate_proxy_list.py
```

```
socks5://37.18.73.60:5566 [美国 加州 圣何塞]
```
